name: Kakugara Jin
source:
Second year student and the only son of Shigehiro.

A typical spoiled brat who grew up spoiled and used his parents' power to do whatever he wanted. He's not good at studying or sports, but he got in through the back door and is in the S class at school.

[Translated from https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonourara/]
